services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Thank you for your interest in having your birthday party at Roswell Gymnastics. Our birthday party program is a fundraiser for our Optional Girls Gymnastics Team. Funds raised are applied to the girls' travel expenses. Our gymnasts and their parents appreciate your support! 17 plus kids $360.00, plus $10.00 per child beginning with 18 and up. Maximum number of 25 kids. Note: Birthday party guests are to be four years old or higher: The maximum number of participants for age 4 birthday party is 16.
